tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Organization/firms/companies having minimum 3 years experience in providing Man power services are eligible to participate.

Experience of providing Manpower Services with the total value not less than 80% of the estimated bid value during preceding three financial years 202324,2024-25 and 2025 26 in a single or multiple orders to Govt/ Semi Govt/ Public sector undertakings

Local Presence: As on the last day of bid submission the Bidder should have had a fully functional Service/Support centre in Karnataka (preferably in Bengalore south Dist.) for a minimum period of 3 years with GST/VAT/Service Tax/Sales Tax Registration.

The bidder should not have been debarred/blacklisted by any State Government, Central Government, Central & State Govt. Undertakings/ enterprises/ Organizations and by any other Quasi Government bodies/ Organizations, Govt E-marketing portal or any major Enterprise / Organization in India for non-satisfactory performance, corrupt & Fraudulent or any other unethical business practices, not meeting critical conditions/security clearance etc during the past. OR Delisted/ barred/penalized by the Government e-Marketing Portal (GeM) for the reasons of not fulfilling or breach of terms of the Portal as on the date of Tender submission.

The bidder should have valid registration Certificate of the following from the appropriate Govt. agencies such as Establishment Registration/ Labour Registration, GST Registration, PF Registration and ESI Registration.

The bidder should have achieved Average Annual turnover of not less than twice the value of estimated bid value during previous three years from 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 OR 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 (in case the Auditing of Annual accounts for the year 2025-26 is completed and the IT Returns are submitted)
